title: Splunk or Wazuh: A Commercial SIEM Leader vs an Open-Source Security Platform
excerpt: For teams starting or rethinking security monitoring. Splunk is a powerful commercial analytics platform; Wazuh is a free, open-source security platform with SIEM and endpoint monitoring features. Cost and in-house skills usually decide.
verdict: Splunk is the better fit for large organisations with the budget for it and large data volumes that need deep, fast analysis. Wazuh is a strong free alternative for smaller teams that want to start security monitoring without licence costs, provided someone is comfortable running Linux infrastructure.
